text:
maya: quick heads-up — i'm drafting the RN for tomorrow's push (10:00-10:30 PT). small surface area but we need explicit hotfix guardrails and a pinned canary plan.
chris: got it. can we add a one-line rollback runbook and the deploybot command to cancel if latency > 200ms?
olivia: I'll take copy for the internal blast. want a short TL;DR + what to watch.
maya: TL;DR idea (feel free to edit):
```
- Upgrade inference runtime -> 2.4.1 (perf fixes, kv-cache stability)
- Canary rollout to 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 30m if metrics OK
- No schema/compatibility changes expected
```
chris: add this guardrail snippet (ops):
```
# rollback quick steps (deploybot)
deploybot cancel --id rb-20250301-3 --reason "latency/regression"
# fallback to pinned model variant
deploybot promote --pin model:v2.3.0
```
olivia: nice. i'll prep the internal announce with that TL;DR + watchlist: latency, error-rate (5xx), token-cost spike.
ryan: SRE side — i'll monitor 1min p95, request errors, and queue depth. if p95 > 200ms or errors > 0.5% escalate immediately. i'll be on-call at deploy time.
sre-oncall: i'm the oncall that window, ping me @ryan and i'll take lead on rollback. also set an automated alert: cpu/gpu utilization > 85% for 3m.
maya: deploybot scheduled the job, FYI:
deploybot: "scheduled deploy rb-20250301-3 by maya at 2025-03-01T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). canary=5% -> 25% -> 100%. notify: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime"
chris: small ask — include a quick command to pin versions in our console UI in case deploybot cancel doesn't work:
```
# console quick pin (frontend)
Model > v2.4.1 > Actions > Pin to traffic (select v2.3.0)
```
olivia: draft internal announce (first pass):
"Team — deploying runtime 2.4.1 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Expect a staged canary. Monitors: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost. SRE oncall: @ryan. If you see regressions, reply here and we will pause and roll back"
chris: maybe add a note about release notes location: link to docs/snippets/release-2025-03-01 (internal).
maya: agreed. olivia — can you post the announce to eng-releases + #all-hands at T+5m if canary OK? otherwise hold.
olivia: yes. i'll prepare two paste variants (hold vs broadcast) and a checklist to follow.
ryan: quick preflight checks i'll run 30m before deploy:
- health checks all green
- canary infra up (5 replicas)
- loadtest smoke (50 qps for 30s)
- KV cache priming sample
chris: also note: if we see a subtle quality regression, we prefer fallback to v2.3.0 pin rather than immediate rollback to reduce cold-start risk. add as policy.
sre-oncall: noted. i'll own the rollback execution and post status updates here.
maya: final ask: olivia, can you include the rollback CLI snippets and the list of owners (SRE, runtime, product) in the announce? will help triage.
olivia: yep. publishing draft for review in 10m.
maya: :thumbsup: thanks all — tagging the production checklist in the deploy ticket now.
chris: leaving a quick comment in the deploy ticket with the canary thresholds and alert hooks.
deploybot: "deploy rb-20250301-3 queued (canary 5%). runbook attached: internal/release/rb-20250301"
maya: closing loop — last_message: draft live, owners assigned, SRE standby confirmed. we'll reconvene in #eng-releases 15m before the window for final green check.
